text: The Worms Cathedral (German: Wormser Dom) is located in Worms, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. It is a 12th-century Romanesque building, built between 1171 and 1234, and is a sandstone building with a polygonal plan. It is a famous relic in the Rhine River Basin.

text: Glasgow Bridge, also known as Jamaica Bridge, is a bridge in the center of Glasgow that spans the Clyde River. It is located near Glasgow Central Station and carries Jamaica Street.

The Hospital Front Street Church, originally known as the Truth Church, is a church in Kaifeng City, Henan Province, China. It was established by the Canadian Anglican Church in 1931 and is located on the Hospital Front Street in the South Gate of Kaifeng. It can accommodate 500 people and is one of the two parishes set up by the church in Kaifeng, along with the Trinity Church. It was closed in 1958 and worship was resumed in 1983. The church is the oldest existing Protestant church in Kaifeng and can no longer accommodate the current 1500 believers.

text: The Big Okhta Bridge, located on the Neva River in St. Petersburg, Russia, is a large bridge. Before 1917, the bridge was named Peter the Great Bridge. The bridge is 334 meters long and 23 meters wide.

The old site of Puji Hospital is located at No. 1 Jiaozhou Road, Shibei District, Qingdao City, Shandong Province, China. It was built in 1919 and is one of the few public buildings built during the first Japanese occupation period that still exist in the old city of Qingdao. It is now used by the headquarters of Qingdao Municipal Hospital.

text: The Křivoklát Castle is a castle located in the town of Křivoklát in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. This castle was built in the 12th century and belonged to the Bohemian king. The castle has experienced many fires in history. Now this castle is a museum.

The Jeya Reservoir  is a large reservoir in Russia, located on the Jeya River next to the city of Jeya in the Amur State north of the border with China. It was completed in 1972, with the water depth controlled at 93 meters. It is the largest hydroelectric power plant in eastern Siberia, and the Baikal-Amur Mainline passes through the north bank.

The Cathedral of Siguenza is a Roman Catholic cathedral in the Spanish city of Siguenza, with a Roman and Gothic exterior. This cathedral is also the cathedral of the Catholic Diocese of Siguenza-Guadalajara. The cathedral was built in 1121.

Dengying Bridge, located in Dulin Village, Cangzhou City, Hebei Province, China, is a national key cultural relics protection unit in Cang County. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is May 2013. The historical era of Dengying Bridge is the Ming Dynasty.

The Chongqing Central Park project was launched in May 2011, construction officially started in June 2011, with a total investment of about 4.6 billion yuan. It was opened to the public in January 2013, and is one of the larger urban parks in China. When completed, it was the largest open urban park in western China.

Pieskowa Skała Castle is a castle in Poland, located 35 kilometers north of Krakow. The castle is built on a limestone cliff and is a Renaissance-style building, which is included in the Ojców National Park. The castle was built during the reign of Casimir III.

text: The Cavenagh Bridge was inaugurated in 1869 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the opening of Singapore. The bridge was named after Sir William O. Cavenagh, the last governor of the Straits Settlements from 1859 to 1867. This bridge is the oldest existing suspension bridge on the Singapore River. In August 2019, which was also the 200th anniversary of the opening of the port, the Singapore government announced that this suspension bridge would be listed as one of the national monuments.

Jining Road Baptist Church is a church in Qingdao City, Shandong Province, People's Republic of China. It was built in 1928 and was established by the Southern Baptist Convention. It is located on the hillside of No. 31 Jining Road  in the North District of the city, and is a magnificent neoclassical style building.
Star Mosque, Bengali Pinyin Taramasjid, is a mosque in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The mosque uses blue star patterns for decoration and was built in the first half of the 19th century.

Gniew Castle is a castle in Poland. This castle was built after 1290 and once belonged to the Teutonic Knights. The castle has been expanded many times in history. In the late 20th century, Gniew Castle was rebuilt.

The Brandenburg Gate is one of the seven existing city gates in the Russian city of Kaliningrad, and it is the only city gate that is still in use in Kaliningrad. The Brandenburg Gate was built in the mid-19th century.

Gaillon Square  is a square in the northwest of the second district of Paris, France, roughly trapezoidal, about 25 meters long and about 15 meters wide. The west side of the square is Port-Mahon Street , the east side is Michaudier Street, the east-west road on the south side of the square is Saint-Augustin Street , and the north side of the square is a building. To the south of the square is Gaillon Street .

The Burrard Bridge (English: Burrard Bridge) is a truss bridge in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, crossing the west end of False Creek and connecting downtown Vancouver and Kitsilano. The bridge currently has five lanes, running through Burrard Street on both sides, and pedestrian and bicycle lanes are set on both sides of the lanes. The Art Deco style of the bridge makes it one of the main landmarks in Vancouver.
The Guiren Stadium is a stadium located in Guiren City, Pingding Province, Vietnam.

Xiaodongying Mosque is a mosque in Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, China. It is one of the five major mosques in Guangzhou, located in Yuexiu District, Yuehua Road, Xiaodongying. The former site of the "March 29th" Uprising Command is nearby.
The ancient Hsiya Mosque is a mosque in Wazirpur Upazila, Barisal City, Barisal Division, Bangladesh.

The Stonewall Library & Archives is a private library located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA, dedicated to collecting historical documents or related publications related to lesbians, gays, bisexuals, and transgender people. The Stonewall Library & Archives has over 18,000 books, films, and DVDs open to the public, making it the library with the largest collection of LGBT artifacts in the southeastern United States.

The Market Street Bridge is a major bridge on Market Street, a main east-west thoroughfare in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States, spanning the Schuylkill River. The current bridge is the fifth permanent bridge built in this area.

Mitsu-do Temple is a temple located in Uji City, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name is Myojyo Mountain, and its principal deity is the Thousand-Hand Kannon. It is the tenth place of worship in the Saigoku 33 Kannon Pilgrimage and is a separate mountain of the Honzan Shugen sect.

Kobayashi Station is located in Kobayashi City, Miyazaki Prefecture, and is a station on the Yoshito Line of Kyushu Passenger Railway . It is also the only manned station on the Yoshito Line in the center of Kobayashi City.
Asteroid 6521  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On June 15, 1991, Eleanor Helin discovered this celestial body at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 63.72660043739769.

Asteroid 5515, also known as 5515 in English, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Eleanor Helin at Palomar Mountain on March 5, 1989. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 46.49282.

Asteroid 5536, also known as 5536 Honeycutt, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. This celestial body was discovered by Indiana University in Morgan County on August 23, 1955. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 124.83870.

Asteroid 5528 is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On January 2, 1992, Kiyotsugu Ueda and Hiroshi Kaneda discovered this celestial body in Kushiro City. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 336.28947.

NGC1234 is a galaxy in the constellation Boötes, discovered by Francis Leavenworth in 1886. NGC1234 is a barred spiral galaxy. The magnitude of this galaxy is 14.2, the surface brightness is 14.6, and other names include "PGC11813" and "MCG-01-09-011".

Ice giants, also known as ocean-like planets, are a type of giant planet mainly composed of gases heavier than hydrogen and helium, such as oxygen, carbon, nitrogen, and sulfur. In the solar system, Uranus and Neptune are typical ice giants. In their mass, only about 20% is hydrogen and helium, while the mass of gaseous giant planets  usually contains more than 90% of hydrogen and helium. In the 1990s, people realized that Uranus and Neptune are a unique class of giant planets, separate from other giant planets.

Asteroid 7853, also known as Confucius Star, was discovered by Dutch astronomers Cornelis Johannes van Houten, Ingrid van Houten-Groeneveld and American astronomer Tom Gehrels on January 29, 1973. Asteroid 7853 is named after Confucius, a famous ancient Chinese educator and the master of Confucian thought.
NGC1082 is a galaxy in the constellation of Eridanus. Its surface is relatively dark, elliptical in shape, with a major axis of about 30", and almost no structure. NGC1082 is classified as S0 type .

Beatrix  is the 83rd asteroid discovered by humans, which was discovered on April 26, 1865. The diameter of Beatrix is 81.4 kilometers, the mass is 5.6×1017 kilograms, and the orbital period is 1385.035 days.

Songshan County, an ancient county name in China. During the Liao Dynasty, it was a county under Songshan Prefecture. The Songshan Prefecture was abolished during the Jin Dynasty. In the third year of Zhongtong in the Yuan Dynasty , it was promoted to Songzhou, and Songshan County remained. In the second year of Zhiyuan , Songshan County was incorporated into Songzhou. Symptoms may be quite mild or quite severe. The typical symptom is severe diarrhea for several days. There may be accompanying vomiting and muscle spasms. text: Feather plucking syndrome appears in various bird species around the world, which is a behavior of birds plucking their own feathers. The causes of feather plucking syndrome vary, and research has found that wild birds pluck their feathers to maintain an appropriate body temperature. Domestic birds and pets may also have feather plucking situations. In addition to maintaining body temperature, the cause may also be psychological factors. Pet birds may vent their emotions through feather plucking behavior. Observations have found that feather plucking may be due to birds feeling neglected, sad, and even when they are joyful, birds may also pluck feathers. When birds show feather plucking behavior, it is recommended to take them to a veterinarian for treatment.

text: The Conger pike eel, also known as the large spotted moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of pike eels, order of Anguilliformes, class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, from the waters of Mauritania and Namibia, and can inhabit depths of up to 45 meters. It can grow up to 150 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling carnivorous fish that feeds on fish and crustaceans. It can be used as a food fish.

The Brown Moray, also known as the Brown Hooked Moray, is a species of the Moray family, a suborder of the Eel order, under the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from the Bermuda Islands, southern Florida in the United States to the northern part of South America; in the Eastern Atlantic region, from Senegal to the waters of Gabon. It inhabits depths of 1-60 meters and can reach a length of 100 centimeters. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in shallow coral reefs and rocky reefs. It is carnivorous, but its habits are not clear. It can be used as a food fish.

The Brown Spotted Naked Chest Eel, also known as the Brown Spotted Naked Chest Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray under the order of Anguilliformes of the class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Indian Pacific region, from East Africa to the waters of the Tuamotu Archipelago, with a habitat depth of up to 25 meters and a body length of up to 20 centimeters. It is a benthic fish that lives in the reef area facing the sea and is carnivorous. Its habits are unknown.

It is named after the former chairman of the Sabah Parks Trust, Ramli Ali. Both of its parents grow at an altitude of 1930 to 1950 meters on Pig Mountain.

The Pairs Dogfish, a species of the family Tetraodontidae in the suborder Tetraodontiformes of the order Fairy Fish of the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in the Fiji waters of the Central and Western Pacific, with a habitat depth of 90-99 meters and a body length of up to 8.1 cm. The Pylospira Octopyle, commonly known as the shell bug, is an animal of the shell bug genus in the stone sun bug family. It is distributed in the North Pacific, including the East Sea and other sea areas.

The Chestnut-tailed Desert Lark (scientific name: Ammomanes phoenicura) is a species of the Desert Lark genus in the Lark family, distributed in India, Nepal, and Pakistan. The conservation status of this species is rated as non-endangered. The average weight of the Chestnut-tailed Desert Lark is about 25.6 grams. Its habitats include subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry grasslands and subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry shrublands.

Petersius conserialis, also known as Peter's characin, is a species of fish in the order Characiformes, suborder Characoidei, and family Alestidae. The Sand smelt (scientific name: Atherina presbyter) is one of the species of the Atherinidae family, distributed in the eastern Atlantic from the UK to the Canary Islands. The killer whale is at the top of the food chain, so it has no natural enemies. The only enemy of the killer whale is humans. Although it has not been targeted by the whaling industry in history, every year there are still several to hundreds of killer whales killed by fishermen. In addition, the industrial wastewater discharged into the sea causes marine pollution, affecting the habitat of killer whales. The sound of the ship's propeller affects the sonar system of the killer whale and scares away the fish. In addition, the overfishing of large marine fish in recent years, especially the sharp decrease in the number of salmon and tuna, which are the main food of the fish-eating killer whales, makes them starve and unable to breed the next generation, affecting the diversity of the killer whale population.

It handles passenger boarding and alighting and freight business , and is a fifth-class station. Both the station and the adjacent up and down sections are electrified sections. There are 17 pairs of trains running daily, with an annual passenger volume of 1500 people.

Qiaotou Town Station is a railway station on the Beijing-Shanghai line, located in Qiaotou Town, Jurong City, Jiangsu Province. It was built in 1928 and is currently a fourth-class station with a postal code of 212413. Current passenger transport: handling passenger boarding and alighting; luggage and parcel consignment; freight: handling whole car cargo delivery; LTL only handles sending; no dangerous goods delivery is handled.

Mentazi Station is a railway station on the Beijing-Shanghai line, located in Mentai Town, Fengyang County, Anhui Province, built in 1909, currently a fourth-class station, with a postal code of 233121. Current passenger transport: handling passenger boarding and alighting; luggage and parcel consignment; freight: handling whole car goods delivery; not handling whole car explosives and whole car primary oxidizer delivery.
Menxian Station is an underground station along Busan Metro Line 2, located in Menxian Cave, South District, Busan Metropolitan City, South Korea.

Cicheng West Station is an underground rail transit station planned in Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, and is the planned western starting point of Ningbo Rail Transit Line 4. The station is located in Cicheng Town, Jiangbei District, and is planned to be put into use in 2024.

Mori Station is a railway station operated by Hokkaido Passenger Railway (JR Hokkaido), located in Mori Town, Kayabe District, Hokkaido, Japan. It is one of the main stations on the JR Hokkaido Hakodate Main Line, and also the junction of the Hakodate Main Line and the Sunahara Branch Line. Mori Station is under the management of JR Hokkaido Hakodate Branch, equipped with station staff, and is responsible for the management of some small nearby stations.
Jigokgol Station is an underground station along Busan Metro Line 2, located in Munhyeon-dong, Nam District, Busan Metropolitan City, South Korea.

Yanyu Bridge Station is located at the intersection of Xinggang Street and Modern Avenue in Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. It was put into use on December 25, 2019, and is a station of Suzhou Rail Transit Line 3. Nearby is the Qinyuan Community.

text: The Takaharu Station, located in Takaharu Town, Nishimoro County, Miyazaki Prefecture, is a station on the Hitoyoshi Line of Kyushu Railway Company . It is the central station of Takaharu Town.

tail.text: Hitoyoshi Line of Kyushu Railway Company

text: Minle Station is an underground station along Busan Metro Line 2, located in Minle Cave, Suyeong District, Busan Metropolitan City, South Korea.

The He Guan Expressway is a highway in Shandong Province, which is part of the Ri Lan Expressway. The starting point is located at the Caozhou hub, connecting to the Ri Dong Expressway, and the end point is at the Lu Yu border, connecting to the Lan Xu Expressway in Henan Province. The total length is 61.547 kilometers, and it was opened to traffic on April 30, 2007.
Jiu Zhang Li Station is located in Wuri District, Taichung City, and is a metro station of the Taichung Metro Green Line .

Abe River Station is a railway station operated by Tokai Passenger Railway , located in Kamita, Suruga Ward, Shizuoka City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. Abe River Station is one of the stations along the Tokaido Main Line owned by JR Tokai, and is a business consignment station entrusted to Tokai Transportation Business, equipped with a green window.

tail.text: Tokaido Main Line owned by JR Tokai

text: Heyuan Station, located in Dongpu Street, Yuancheng District, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province, China, is a train station on the Beijing-Kowloon Railway and Guangzhou-Meizhou-Shantou Railway. It was built in 1990 and is under the jurisdiction of Guangzhou Railway Group.

Murasakino Station is a railway station operated by East Japan Railway Company , located in Murasakino, Kitakami City, Iwate Prefecture, Japan. Murasakino is a station along the JR Tohoku Main Line, and is under the jurisdiction of the JR East Morioka Branch. It is a station where station staff are dispatched from Kitakami Station.

The Charlotte Area Transit System is a light rail system operated by the Charlotte Transit Authority in the Charlotte area of North Carolina, USA. The system has only one line, 36 stations, and a total length of 9.6 miles , with a daily passenger flow of 16,000 people.
